quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on his return to the Phoenix Suns
quotes.excerpt: I spent eight years with these guys, nine years. So, you know, I'm definitely excited.
quotes.quote: It feels good, you know. I mean, it's just another game, but I spent eight years with these guys, nine years. So, you know, I'm definitely excited, but getting the W is the most important thing.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the difficulty of winning in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It really taught me how hard it is to win in the NBA.
quotes.quote: It was a grind. It really taught me how hard it is to win in the NBA. I thought we had a pretty solid team to make the playoffs and we didn't a couple years. But you know, I had a great time there. They treated me like family. Charlotte will always be family to me, but they really taught me about how hard it is to win in the NBA.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges reflects on his time in Charlotte: It really taught me how hard it is to win in the NBA. They treated me like family, and Charlotte will always be family to me.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the Suns' defensive focus
quotes.excerpt: We're trying to get better defensively, and that comes with talking and giving extra effort.
quotes.quote: We're trying to get better defensively, and that comes with talking and giving extra effort. We've been hitting hard on that lately. And then trying to get more rebounds. We got to get more rebounds, get out in transition, and go because that's when we're at our best.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges on the Suns defensive focus: We are trying to get better defensively, and that comes with talking and giving extra effort. We have been hitting hard on that lately.

structured.context: Miles Bridges explains the Phoenix Suns' current focus on defensive improvement and rebounding.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on his need to improve post play
quotes.excerpt: I got to start converting more in the post, you know. I'm not doing a good job.
quotes.quote: I got to start converting more in the post, you know. I'm not doing a good job. I don't think of taking advantage of mismatches. DB has been good all year with that type of stuff. I need to learn a few things from him, but you know, I'm going to get better as the season goes on.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges admits he needs to improve his post play: I do not think I am doing a good job of taking advantage of mismatches. DB has been good all year with that, and I need to learn a few things from him.

structured.context: Miles Bridges discusses his need to improve his post play and learn from teammate Devin Booker.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the Suns' ball movement and spacing

quotes.quote: We're moving it around, trying to get to the second side more. Book had it going the last few games, so you know, try to get it to him, but at the same time try to keep it moving.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges on the Suns offensive approach: We are moving it around, trying to get to the second side more. Book had it going the last few games, so try to get it to him, but keep it moving.

quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the challenge of playing against Charlotte
quotes.excerpt: They got a lot of people that can score the ball, you know. Naz Reid can score.
quotes.quote: Nah, because they got a lot of people that can score the ball, you know. Naz Reid can score 30 at any moment, Kobe, Grayson. You know, you've seen Grayson play. quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the keys to beating Charlotte
quotes.excerpt: Try to turn them over and keep them off the offensive glass.
quotes.quote: I'd say moving in second, third side, attacking closeouts, taking advantage of mismatches. That's basically it, you know. We got four guys that scored 20 plus in their career multiple times. So, you know, just finding the mismatches and seeing if we could exploit it. Try to turn them over and keep them off the offensive glass. Musa is a monster down there. I feel like as long as we don't turn the ball over, we make them turn the ball over, and we rebound the ball, we'll be good.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges on the keys to beating Charlotte: Just finding the mismatches and seeing if we could exploit it. We need to turn them over and keep them off the offensive glass.

structured.context: Miles Bridges outlines the keys to victory for the Phoenix Suns against the Charlotte Hornets.
